maybe_specialist:
    cmp dword ptr [ebp - 0x08], 37

water_capped:

water_zero:

water_ready:
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x10], eax

    push edi

    mov eax, 0x4e6260

finished:
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret
